baseline_observation: Product Design v6 provides briefs, reference transfer, hierarchy, and rendered-check guidance, but lacks a unified token and component lifecycle, fixed surface scan, material value lineage, and system assurance scope.
candidate_observation: Product Design v7 requires exact-task shipped-state research, transfer limits, system scope, foundation-to-semantic-to-component-when-needed lineage, lifecycle, Korean and responsive scenarios, and decision-bound renders.
